name: Shanxi Lu'an Chemical Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanxi Lu'an Chemical Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells coal chemical products and chemical equipment in China. The company offers urea, polyvinyl chloride, propylene, ion membrane caustic soda, phosphorus trichloride, and hydrogen peroxide for the agriculture and chemical industries, as well as fertilizers, LNG, liquid ammonia, and hydrogen. It is also involved in the design, manufacture, production, and sale of chemical machinery and equipment; engineering survey and design; hydrogen energy technology consulting services; and the assembly, production, and sale of intelligent systems and components for new energy vehicles.
